reading.pronunciation_held: every CER interval includes zero and every mean is slightly negative: the adaptation did not cost intelligibility
reading.what_it_cannot_say: eight of the nine development speakers are Common Voice, which OmniVoice has very probably trained on, and the adaptation's training data is Common Voice and Neyshekar. An uplift here can be domain familiarity rather than better cloning. The sealed test on Neyshekar's unseen speakers is what answers it, and nothing here touched a test clip
